verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a CRM, since open-source CRMs exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Freshsales publishing its source under an open license. The evidence covers only a proprietary REST API, product marketing and a pricing page, and none of that is about source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
